messages:
Nina C.: FYI invoice #6122 (client: Aurelia Systems) for $32,412.30 came back as ACH return R07 (authorization revoked). BillingBot alerted this morning.
BillingBot: Automated: payment_failed - invoice:6122 - amount:$32412.30 - method:ACH - return_code:R07 - ts:2026-03-06T09:04:12Z
Omar R.: Do we have a signed ACH form on file? if yes, one re-present is allowed per policy.
Nina C.: Yes, auth on file (AUTH-2024-112). I left voicemail and sent our standard dunning note.
Hannah P.: For this material amount I'd avoid immediate external collections. Suggest: 1) schedule single re-present, 2) offer a short 2-payment plan (50/50) if they accept within 5 business days, 3) waive the $250 late fee if plan accepted, 4) require e-signature + autopay for installments.
Legal Ops: Confirm policy: one re-present ok if auth exists. Include clear dispute instructions and pause further attempts if customer claims revoked auth. Add clause requiring signed arrangement and autopay for payment plans.
Nina C.: Plan: schedule re-present for next bank window (tomorrow 09:00 PT), email CC AE & SalesOps with 5-day acceptance window, include fee waiver and card/wire options (card +2.5% fee). If no response, escalate to collections in 10 days.
CollectionsBot: Policy note recorded: R07 with signed auth -> one re-present allowed. Default collections escalation after 10 days if unpaid and no arrangement.
Omar R.: Approved. Please tag AE in CRM and set dunning_status=reattempt_pending. Keep Legal Ops copied on outbound email.
BillingBot: Action logged: reattempt_scheduled - invoice:6122 - attempt_time:2026-03-07T16:00:00Z - initiated_by:Nina C.
Nina C.: Drafted email and CCed Legal. Will call AE now and update thread after re-present. :phone:
